pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take:
**Mustard Boy, your fantasy picks are as disappointing as a ketchup-stained tie at a mustard convention.** Let me tell you something, Zach: when you picked Brazil, you probably thought you were drafting Pelé, but buddy, this is 2026 and your once-mighty Seleção is tripping over their own samba steps. Switzerland and Austria? You could've picked two different shades of beige and they'd have more flair. Ghana might have some grit, but Czechia and Saudi Arabia? That's like painting a masterpiece and then spilling coffee on it. Look me in the eyes, Mustard Boy: you're sitting at fourth with 35 measly points, and you're the epitome of mediocrity in a sport that demands not just vision, but guts. I'm calling it now: Foxborough will be another nail in your yellow coffin, the only thing magical here is how you've managed to avoid complete embarrassment.

And Bubba G, Gunner, let's break down your genius move of picking Egypt. How'd that work out against Argentina, huh? Zero points, flat as a pancake. You're leading the pack right now, but don't get too comfortable; this race is a marathon, not a sprint through a Parisian pastry shop. France might be carrying you, but even they have croissant-style flakiness on occasion. Here's my prediction: you'll cling to first place tighter than a bobble-head on a dashboard, but just barely. You'll need something more than hope and baguettes to fend off Ghost Pepper.

Speaking of you, Ghost Pepper, Devin, your spicy moves with Spain and the US might have catapulted you into second place, but let's face it, buddy: Bosnia will sink you faster than a lead balloon. You're sitting at 58 points — impressive, but not enough. Look at me, Devin: you picked Haiti. You might as well have chosen hope and dreams because they're about as tangible. Don't get too cocky; you're only second best.

And The Backpass Assassin, Gayden, third place is just a fancy way to say almost forgotten, isn't it? With England leading your pack, you'd expect more from a nation that invented the darn game. Your fascination with Japan and Korea Republic only shows that you've got more style than substance. Trust me, you'll need more than two upset points if you want to leapfrog into relevance. You might advance on some miracle, but even that will be as sturdy as a card castle in a windstorm
